reproducibility.evidence: Single Python runner, local Futurist humanoid asset, deterministic obstacle file, validator, and generated artifacts.

mujoco_depth.evidence: Imports existing Futurist humanoid URDF into MuJoCo, adds free base, assembled 3D obstacle geoms, lights, camera, and dynamic route markers.

task_design.evidence: Real-world autonomous obstacle course with stairs, ramps, curbs, gaps, barriers, posts, signs, crates, and pipe clutter.

control.evidence: Perception-driven lane scoring chooses left, right, clear walking, or stair/ramp ascent at runtime.

dexterity.evidence: Not a manipulation task; complexity is in legged navigation and obstacle reasoning.

engineering_quality.evidence: Submission is modular, documented, and exports trajectory, decisions, report, and demo video.

presentation.evidence: Video shows the robot route, obstacle field, scan choices, and active decision beacon.

innovation.evidence: Combines real-world obstacle semantics with explainable autonomous route decisions using the provided robot asset.
